description: A single dual-axis line plot (no panel letters) reporting the elastic constants of the Fe(1-x)Mn(x)Al system as a function of Mn content. The x-axis is labelled "Mn content" with ticks at 0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.5, 0.6, 0.8 and 1.0; the left y-axis is "Young's modulus / GPa" spanning 160-300 GPa, and the right y-axis is "C11-C12" (GPa) spanning 40-160. Two square-marker curves are plotted, each at nine compositions from x = 0 to x = 1.0: a red curve labelled E and a blue curve labelled C11-C12. Two horizontal arrows indicate axis assignment: a red arrow pointing left for E (left axis) and a blue arrow pointing right for C11-C12 (right axis). Both curves describe the same shape: they fall steeply from the highest values near Mn content 0 (FeAl) to a pronounced minimum at Mn content 0.5, then recover to a local maximum near Mn content 0.875, and finally drop sharply again at Mn content 1.0 (MnAl). No numeric data labels are printed, so values are read only against the gridlines. The figure demonstrates that Young's modulus and C11-C12 track each other, both being lowest for Fe0.5Mn0.5Al and highest for the end-members.

observations.observation: The figure is a dual-y-axis plot: left axis 'Young's modulus / GPa' (160-300 GPa) and right axis 'C11-C12' (scaled 40-160), against x-axis 'Mn content' from 0 to 1.0.
Two square-marker curves are plotted: a red curve labelled E and a blue curve labelled C11-C12, each with nine points across the Mn content range 0 to 1.0.
A red arrow pointing left and a blue arrow pointing right associate E with the left y-axis and C11-C12 with the right y-axis, and the caption-stated pairing matches this.
Both curves decrease steeply from Mn content 0 (FeAl) down to a minimum at Mn content 0.5.
After the minimum at Mn content 0.5 both curves rise to a local maximum at Mn content 0.875 (given by the eighth data point), then fall sharply at Mn content 1.0 (MnAl).
At Mn content 0 the red E curve lies just below the 300 GPa gridline and the blue C11-C12 curve lies at the 160 top gridline; at Mn content 1.0 both curves drop to the low end of their axes.
At the minimum (Mn content 0.5) the red E point falls between the 200 and 220 GPa gridlines and the blue C11-C12 point sits just above the 60 gridline of the right axis.
No numeric data labels are printed on any marker; values are only readable against the axis tick gridlines.
The caption states the figure shows variations in (C11-C12) and Young's modulus of the Fe1-xMnxAl system.
The citing text states that Young's modulus and C11-C12 follow a similar variation trend in Fig. 5, which the plotted curve shapes support.
The citing text associates the Fe0.5Mn0.5Al composition with the extrema (lowest C11, maximum C12, minimum C44 and E, maximum Poisson's ratio) among the Fe0.875Mn0.125Al to Fe0.125Mn0.875Al series.
